overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（4 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、银行与信贷（2 篇）。方法上以回归分析、随机实验为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Measuring the drawdown risk and recovery potential of self-regulatory organizations in response to war events
papers.abstract:
Purpose
                    The purpose of this study is to assess the impact of war events on the performance of self-regulatory organizations (SROs), specifically equity markets. Furthermore, it is segregated into classifications: developing, emerging, stand-alone and frontier regions, including America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa and the Pacific. This study aims to precisely quantify and assess war-induced volatility and drawdown risks across global SROs, with a focus on structural breaks and recovery potential.
                  
                  
                    Design/methodology/approach
                    The sample data includes daily SRO returns from 80 countries between January 3, 2022 and December 31, 2024. Various methodologies are used; the Chow test is used to identify structural breaks during the Russia–Ukraine war. The GARCH model estimates the volatility series, and impulse indicator saturation (IIS) is applied to the event-window analysis. Maximum drawdown is widely used as a key measure of downside risk. The Calmar ratio (CR) provides a risk-adjusted performance measure that captures the speed and strength of the SRO’s recovery after major disruptions. The coefficient of variation is used in CRs to ensure robustness.
                  
                  
                    Findings
                    The standalone SROs are most affected and face high drawdown risk. The European SROs have been severely shaken by the Ukraine crisis, while Asian SROs have been slightly affected. The developed SROs are less exposed to such shocks and have a chance of a speedy recovery. The emerging and frontier SROs have similar drawdown ratios, but the frontier SROs show lower strength ratios and weak recovery capacity.
                  
                  
                    Research limitations/implications
                    This study used data on developing, emerging, stand-alone and frontier SROs, but it could be extended by conducting an analysis across regions.
                  
                  
                    Practical implications
                    The paper can be extended to include further SROs in the region over a wide range of data.
                  
                  
                    Originality/value
                    This study makes a novel contribution by using the IIS approach, structural break testing, volatility modeling and reaction and recovery estimators to explore war-induced uncertainty in SROs worldwide with greater precision. Unlike previous research, the approach simultaneously identifies unexpected events, volatility due to disruptions and market sensitivity across regions, and classifies SROs. This combined methodology provides a data-driven, comprehensive understanding of how war-induced and geopolitical crises emerge and spread worldwide.
papers.summary_zh:
【风险管理与衍生品】**研究目的**  
本研究的目的是评估战争事件对自我监管组织（Self-Regulatory Organizations, SROs）表现的影响，特别是对股票市场的影响。研究将全球市场划分为不同类别，包括发达国家、新兴市场、独立市场以及前沿市场，涵盖美国、欧洲、亚洲、中东、非洲和太平洋地区。本研究旨在精确量化并评估战争引发的波动性及市场下跌风险，重点关注市场结构的突变及其恢复潜力。

**研究设计/方法论**  
样本数据涵盖了2022年1月3日至2024年12月31日期间80个国家的每日市场表现数据。研究采用了多种方法：使用Chow检验来识别俄罗斯-乌克兰战争期间的市场结构突变；GARCH模型用于估计市场波动性；同时运用脉冲指标饱和度（Impulse Indicator Saturation, IIS）对事件窗口进行分析；最大跌幅被广泛用作衡量下行风险的关键指标；Calmar比率（CR）则是一种风险调整后的绩效指标，能够反映市场在重大冲击后的恢复速度和能力；变异系数（Coefficient of Variation）被用于增强CR指标的稳健性。

**研究结果**  
独立市...。研究方法：GARCH 波动率模型。

papers.title: Analisis dan Perbandingan Algoritma SVR, XGBOOST, dan Lightgbm dalam Prediksi Cryptocurrency Ethereum
papers.venue: Comit Communication Information and Technology Journal
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze and compare the performance of three algorithms, namely Support Vector Regression (SVR) with a linear kernel, XGBoost, and LightGBM, in predicting the Price of Ethereum cryptocurrency based on daily historical data. The study uses Ethereum Price data in USD for the last five years obtained from the investing.com website. The variables used are Close, Open, High, and Low Prices. The study uses two data splitting scenarios: 80% training data and 20% testing data, and 70% training data and 30% testing data. This study also uses time step variations to test the effect of time dependency on algorithm performance. The results indicate that the LightGBM algorithm has the best performance compared to the other two algorithms with an average MAE value for High Price of 75.486, SVR has a value of 115.590, and XGBoost has a value of 77.314 in the 80% training data and 20% testing data split. In the 70% training data and 30% testing data split, the LightGBM algorithm still excels with an average MAE value for High Price of 78.228, SVR of 104.356, and XGBoost of 83.573. Other evaluations such as RMSE and R2 also show the superiority of the LightGBM algorithm. For the required computation time, the SVR algorithm outperforms the other two algorithms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本研究旨在分析和比较三种算法在基于每日历史数据预测以太坊加密货币价格方面的性能，这三种算法分别是采用线性核的支持向量回归（SVR）、XGBoost和LightGBM。研究使用了来自investing.com网站的过去五年以太坊价格数据（以美元计），所使用的变量包括收盘价（Close）、开盘价（Open）、最高价（High）和最低价（Low）。研究采用了两种数据分割方案：80%的训练数据和20%的测试数据，以及70%的训练数据和30%的测试数据。此外，研究还通过调整时间步长来测试时间依赖性对算法性能的影响。结果表明，在80%训练数据和20%测试数据的分割方案中，LightGBM算法的表现最佳，其最高价的平均绝对误差（MAE）为75.486；SVR的MAE为115.590，XGBoost的MAE为77.314。在70%训练数据和30%测试数据的分割方案中，LightGBM依然表现出色，其最高价的平均MAE为78.228，SVR为104.356，XGBoost为83.573。其他评估指标（如均方根误差RMSE和R2）也显示了LightGBM算法的优越性。在计算时间方面，SVR算法的表现...。研究方法：回归分析、XGBoost。

papers.title: A Simple Approximation to the Distribution of the Ridge Regression Estimator
papers.abstract: We present a simple Gaussian approximation to the finite-sample distribution of the classical ridge regression estimator. Our approximation captures the fact that, in finite samples, the ridge regression estimator trades off bias and variance to reduce estimation and prediction error. Our approximation is based on nonstandard asymptotics where $i)$ we let the estimator's regularization parameter grow proportionally to the sample size; and $ii)$ we treat the population regression coefficients as \emph{local} to the reference vector that defines the estimator's direction of shrinkage. In contrast to other asymptotic approximations in the literature, we allow for general forms of heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation in the data generating process (at the cost of considering a low-dimensional model where the number of covariates is not allowed to grow with the sample size). We use our simple Gaussian approximation to propose two new strategies to select the regularization parameter for the ridge regression estimator. The suggested strategies select the regularization parameter to minimize either average or worst-case excess prediction risk, where risk is computed using our suggested Gaussian approximation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种简单的高斯近似方法，用于描述经典岭回归估计量的有限样本分布。这种近似方法揭示了这样一个事实：在有限样本情况下，岭回归估计量通过权衡偏差和方差来降低估计误差和预测误差。我们的近似方法基于非标准的渐近理论，具体包括：$i)$ 使估计量的正则化参数与样本量成比例增长；$ii)$ 将总体回归系数视为相对于定义估计量收缩方向的参考向量的“局部”变量。与文献中的其他渐近近似方法不同，我们的方法允许数据生成过程中存在异方差性和自相关性（但为此需要采用低维模型，即协变量的数量不允许随样本量的增加而增加）。我们利用这种简单的高斯近似方法提出了两种新的策略来选择岭回归估计量的正则化参数。这些建议的策略旨在通过最小化平均预测风险或最坏情况下的预测风险来选择正则化参数，其中风险的计算是基于我们提出的高斯近似方法进行的。。研究方法：回归分析、岭回归。

papers.title: Robust Scale-Free Auctions
papers.abstract: We study prior-independent auction design when bidder values are independently and identically distributed and the seller knows only a scale-invariant shape restriction on their distribution, but neither the distribution nor the scale of values. We show that the maximin problem over a broad class of dominant-strategy incentive-compatible mechanisms reduces without loss to scale-free mechanisms. For any $n\ge 2$ monotone-hazard-rate bidders, the second-price auction without a reserve is maximin optimal over this class, including randomized mechanisms that may allocate to a lower bidder. We derive its exact guarantee for every $n$ and the sharp exponential rate at which its loss relative to the Bayesian optimum vanishes. Many familiar auctions are standard: they allocate only to a highest bidder, although incentive compatibility does not require this. For two regular bidders, we solve the standard problem exactly: its optimal mechanism mixes the second-price auction with a relative-markup auction and achieves a worst-case ratio of approximately $0.524413$. We construct a nonstandard mechanism that sometimes allocates to the lower bidder and achieves approximately $0.524829$, proving that standardness is strictly costly. The contrast is driven by tail restrictions: monotone hazard rate makes lower-rank allocation unhelpful, whereas regularity permits it to improve worst-case revenue.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】我们研究了在竞买者价值服从独立同分布（i.i.d.）情形下的拍卖设计问题。在这种情况下，卖方仅知道竞买者价值分布的某种尺度不变性质，但既不知道具体的分布形式，也不知道价值的实际尺度。我们证明了：在广泛的主导策略激励相容（incentive-compatible）拍卖机制类别中，最优解可以通过简化处理转化为无尺度限制的拍卖机制来获得。对于任意$n \geq 2$个具有单调风险率（monotone-hazard rate）的竞买者而言，无保留价的第二价格拍卖（second-price auction）是这类机制中的最优选择，其中甚至包括可能将拍卖物品分配给较低出价者的随机化拍卖机制。我们为每种$n$值精确地推导出了该拍卖机制的最优性保证，并确定了其相对于贝叶斯最优解（Bayesian optimum）的亏损以指数速率快速收敛的临界条件。

许多常见的拍卖机制其实属于标准类型：它们仅将物品分配给出价最高的竞买者，尽管激励相容性并不强制要求必须如此。对于两个常规竞买者的情况，我们精确地解决了该标准拍卖问题，发现其最优机制结合了第二价格拍卖与相对加价拍卖（relative-markup a...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、随机实验。

papers.title: Sustainable investing under uncertainty: A dual-criterion probabilistic framework
papers.abstract: This study proposes an ambiguity-aware framework for optimal asset allocation under uncertainty in firms’ ESG scores. Unlike traditional sustainable investing models that assume fully reliable ESG information, the proposed approach explicitly accounts for imperfect and noisy ESG signals by jointly integrating financial and sustainability criteria in a probabilistic setting. Portfolio weights are modeled as random variables, and low informativeness in ESG scores, measured through a signal-to-noise ratio, is penalized by reallocating assets toward financially robust investments when ESG information is weak or ambiguous. Empirical results show that the proposed framework promotes greater diversification and delivers enhanced robustness to parameter uncertainty, exhibiting lower sensitivity to model assumptions and more stable out-of-sample performance compared to standard expected-utility-based ESG portfolios.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究提出了一种能够识别不确定性的框架，用于在企业ESG评分存在不确定性时的最优资产配置。与传统可持续投资模型不同，这些模型假设ESG信息完全可靠，而所提出的方法通过将财务标准和可持续性标准结合在概率框架中，明确考虑了ESG信号的不完美性和噪声。投资组合权重被建模为随机变量；当ESG信息较弱或存在不确定性时，通过信号与噪声比来衡量ESG评分的信息含量较低，该方法会通过将资产重新分配到财务稳健的投资项目中来进行惩罚。实证结果表明，所提出的框架能够提高投资组合的多元化程度，并增强对参数不确定性的抵御能力，相较于基于预期效用的传统ESG投资组合，该框架对模型假设的敏感性更低，样本外表现更为稳定。。

papers.title: Strategi Pemasaran BPRS Harta Insan Karimah dalam Meningkatkan Minat Masyarakat terhadap Produk Perbankan Syariah
papers.venue: Journal of islamic economics and finance
papers.abstract: This study aims to examine the marketing strategies adopted by BPRS HIK Bekasi to increase public interest in Islamic banking products and services while identifying the factors that shape their effectiveness within the local market context. The study is important because the substantial potential of the Islamic banking industry in Indonesia has not yet translated into proportionate market penetration, partly due to limited Islamic financial literacy, public perceptions, and competition from conventional banks. A descriptive qualitative approach was employed, with data collected through direct observation, interviews with BPRS HIK Bekasi staff, documentation of promotional materials and marketing activities, and a review of relevant literature. The data were analyzed thematically by integrating empirical findings with theoretical perspectives on Islamic banking marketing strategies. The findings indicate that marketing effectiveness depends not only on the implementation of the marketing mix but also on the bank's ability to integrate Islamic financial literacy education, service quality improvement, product innovation, relationship-based approaches, and digital media optimization. The findings imply that adaptive marketing strategies aligned with local market characteristics are essential for expanding market reach and strengthening public trust in Islamic banking. The originality of this study lies in integrating marketing strategies, Islamic financial literacy education, and digital transformation within the context of a rural Islamic bank operating in the Bekasi local market. This perspective extends the existing literature by providing a more context-sensitive understanding of Islamic banking marketing at the micro and regional levels.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在考察BPRS HIK Bekasi采用的营销策略，以增加公众对伊斯兰银行产品与服务的兴趣，并识别影响其有效性的关键因素。

🔬 研究方法：采用描述性定性方法，通过直接观察、访谈、文档记录及文献综述收集数据，并运用主题分析法整合实证发现与理论视角。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，营销有效性不仅取决于营销组合的实施，还取决于银行整合伊斯兰金融素养教育、提升服务质量、产品创新、关系导向方法及数字媒体优化的能力。

💡 应用价值：研究表明，与当地市场特征相适应的适应性营销策略对于扩大市场覆盖面和加强公众对伊斯兰银行的信任至关重要。

papers.title: Predictive Risk Scores in the Public Sector: Experimental Evidence from Child-Protection Investigations
papers.abstract: Many public-sector decisions require allocating scarce attention under uncertainty. We examine whether algorithmic risk assessments improve child-protection decisions, where supervisors decide which cases need closer scrutiny. In a randomized evaluation of 4,752 child referrals over 14 months in Northampton County, supervisors received an algorithmic risk score alongside standard case records. Access to the score increased foster-care placements and services for children at highest predicted risk, with little change for lower-risk cases, and it reduced subsequent maltreatment referrals. We find no evidence that the score widened racial disparities in decisions or outcomes, suggesting algorithms can improve targeting while preserving human discretion.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】许多公共部门的决策需要在不确定性条件下对有限的资源进行分配。我们研究了算法风险评估是否能够改善儿童保护决策——在这些决策中，主管需要判断哪些案例需要更深入的审查。在北安普顿县进行的为期14个月的随机评估中，4,752起儿童转介案例中，主管除了收到标准案例记录外，还获得了算法计算出的风险评分。结果显示，对于预测风险最高的儿童，该评分有助于增加他们获得寄养安置和服务的机会，而对风险较低的儿童影响较小；同时，该评分还减少了后续发生的虐待事件报告。研究未发现该评分会加剧决策或结果中的种族差异，这表明算法能够在保留人类判断力的同时提高决策的精准度。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
papers.abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为了研究在金融相互依存背景下现有大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个包含微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。由于货币专业化中介的存在，搜索摩擦在资产市场层面和货币区域层面产生了不同的流动性概念，这些概念共同决定了货币竞争的走向。以中美关系为例，在中国金融发展的初期阶段，与中国美元区进行资产整合使中国受益，从而巩固了现有的国际货币格局。随着中国金融市场的深化，人民币的发行使中国能够内部化网络效应，并逐渐削弱美元的主导地位，进而引发国际货币体系的多元化趋势。这一转变还受到制裁、金融抑制措施以及第三方国家反应的影响，这凸显了金融相互依存如何在国际金融秩序的演变过程中将合作转变为竞争关系。。

papers.title: Analysis of educated unemployment in Indonesia 2015-2024
papers.abstract: This study examines the effects of the Provincial Minimum Wage or Upah Minimum Provinsi (UMP), Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP), and Mean Years of Schooling (MYS) on educated unemployment across Indonesian provinces from 2015 to 2024. Panel data from all 34 provinces were analyzed using panel data regressions. The simultaneous test confirms that all three variables significantly influence educated unemployment, with an R-squared value of 0.9732, indicating strong explanatory power. Partially, the minimum wage shows a negative and significant effect, consistent with efficiency wage theory, suggesting that wage increases are associated with greater labor market participation among educated workers. GRDP shows a positive and significant effect, consistent with a jobless growth pattern in which economic expansion is driven largely by capital-intensive sectors that absorb limited amounts of educated labor. Similarly, MYS positively and significantly affects educated unemployment, consistent with structural educational mismatch and over-education, where rising educational attainment outpaces the growth of qualified job opportunities, a condition associated with educated workers remaining voluntarily unemployed rather than accepting mismatched positions. By covering all 34 provinces over a full decade, this study extends prior, more geographically limited research and shows that provincial economic growth and rising educational attainment can coincide with, rather than reduce, the educated unemployment. These findings highlight the multidimensional nature of educated unemployment in Indonesia, requiring integrated policy responses, including aligning educational curricula with labor market demands, promoting labor-intensive and inclusive economic growth, and sustaining evidence-based minimum-wage policies across regions.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】本研究探讨了2015年至2024年间印度尼西亚各省的最低工资标准（Upah Minimum Provinsi，简称UMP）、地区国内生产总值（GRDP）以及平均受教育年限（MYS）对受过教育的失业人员数量的影响。研究采用了涵盖所有34个省份的面板数据，并通过面板数据分析方法进行了分析。同步检验结果显示，这三个变量均对受过教育的失业率具有显著影响，R平方值为0.9732，表明其解释能力较强。其中，最低工资标准呈现出负向且显著的效应，这与效率工资理论相符，即工资上涨会促进受过教育的劳动者更多地参与劳动力市场。地区国内生产总值则呈现出正向且显著的效应，这可能与“失业增长模式”有关——即经济增长主要由资本密集型行业驱动，而这些行业吸纳的受过教育的劳动力有限。平均受教育年限同样对受过教育的失业率有显著的正向影响，这反映了教育结构与就业需求之间的不匹配以及过度教育的问题：随着受教育程度的提高，合格就业机会的增长速度未能跟上，导致受过教育的劳动者选择自愿失业而非接受与自身技能不匹配的工作。由于本研究覆盖了全部34个省份并涵盖了整整十年的时间跨度，因此它扩展了以往仅局限于特定地区的同类研究，表明...。研究方法：面板数据、回归分析。

papers.title: Pengaruh Perkembangan Peer-to-Peer Lending terhadap Penyaluran Kredit Bank KBMI 1 di Indonesia
papers.venue: El-Mal Jurnal Kajian Ekonomi & Bisnis Islam
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of peer-to-peer (P2P) lending in Indonesia raises questions about its impact on banking intermediation, particularly in Bank KBMI 1. This study analyzes the effect of P2P lending growth on Bank KBMI 1 credit growth using monthly data from October 2021 to June 2025 and the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) method. The results indicate that P2P lending outstanding and the number of borrowers have no significant long-run effect on credit growth, although they are associated with short-run financing dynamics. Meanwhile, third-party funds and inflation positively and significantly affect credit growth, whereas the BI7DRR has no significant effect. These findings suggest that P2P lending has not replaced the intermediation role of Bank KBMI 1 but instead tends to develop alongside the banking sector in meeting financing needs.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】印度尼西亚点对点（P2P）借贷的快速增长引发了关于其对银行业中介服务影响的问题，尤其是对KBMI 1银行的影响。本研究利用2021年10月至2025年6月的月度数据，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）方法，分析了P2P借贷增长对KBMI 1银行信贷增长的影响。研究结果表明，P2P借贷的未偿还余额和借款人数对信贷增长没有显著的长期影响，但它们与短期融资动态存在关联。与此同时，第三方资金和通货膨胀对信贷增长具有显著的正向影响，而BI7DRR指标则没有显著影响。这些发现表明，P2P借贷并未取代KBMI 1银行的中介职能，而是在满足融资需求的过程中与银行业共同发展。。

papers.title: <b>Why Qualified Students Do Not Enter Higher Education: A Behavioural Economics Analysis of Rural–Urban Inequalities in Ghana</b><b></b>
papers.abstract:
Purpose: This study investigates the transition from secondary to higher education among academically qualified youth in Ghana, focusing on the behavioural and spatial factors influencing enrolment. It examines how geographic isolation, information asymmetry, bounded rationality, and status quo bias contribute to self-exclusion from tertiary education, particularly in rural areas.
Methodology: The study uses nationally representative data from the Ghana Living Standards Survey Round 7 (GLSS 7), comprising 5,142 respondents aged 15–25 who completed Senior High School or its equivalent. A binary Probit model estimates the probability of tertiary transition based on rural residence, household ICT access, parental education, wealth status, and gender. An interaction term tests whether ICT access reduces the disadvantages associated with rural residence.
Results: A significant rural–urban disparity exists, with tertiary transition rates of 6.1% in rural areas compared with 34.2% in urban areas. Rural residence reduces the probability of transition by 14.5 percentage points, while household ICT access increases it by 9.8 percentage points. ICT access significantly mitigates the negative effects of geographic isolation. Parental higher education has a modest positive influence, whereas gender is not statistically significant.
Novelty and Contribution: The study extends human capital theory by showing that behavioural and informational barriers, alongside financial constraints, shape tertiary education transitions.
Practical and Social Implications: Expanding digital connectivity and providing school-based application support can reduce cognitive barriers, overcome status quo bias, and promote more equitable access to higher education.
papers.summary_zh:
【收入分配与福利】**研究目的**：本研究探讨了加纳学术成绩优异的青少年从中等教育向高等教育过渡的过程，重点分析了影响其入学决策的行为因素和空间因素。研究分析了地理隔离、信息不对称、有限理性以及现状偏见如何导致他们主动放弃接受高等教育的机会，尤其是在农村地区。

**研究方法**：本研究采用了加纳第七次生活水平调查（GLSS 7）的全国代表性数据，样本包括5,142名年龄在15至25岁之间、已完成高中或同等学历的受访者。通过二元Probit模型，研究基于居住地（农村或城市）、家庭信息通信技术（ICT）普及程度、父母教育水平及性别等因素，估算了青少年进入高等教育的概率。同时，研究还设置了交互项以检验ICT普及程度是否能够缓解农村居住所带来的不利影响。

**研究结果**：研究发现城乡之间存在显著差异：农村地区的青少年进入高等教育的比例仅为6.1%，而城市地区这一比例为34.2%。居住在农村地区会降低青少年进入高等教育的概率14.5个百分点，而家庭ICT普及程度则会提高这一概率9.8个百分点。ICT普及显著减轻了地理隔离带来的负面影响。父母接受过高等教育的家庭对子女接受高等教育有积极的促进作用，但性别...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Pengaruh Loan Disburesement, Non – Performing Loan (NPL), dan Current Account Saving Account (CASA) Rasio Terhadap Profitabilitas Bank Himbara dan Bank Asing
papers.venue: El-Mal Jurnal Kajian Ekonomi & Bisnis Islam
papers.abstract: This study aims to determine the effect of the amount of credit disbursed (Loan Disbursement) based on economic sectors, non-performing loans (NPL), current accounts - savings accounts (CASA) on the profitability of national banks and foreign banks operating in Indonesia. The approach used is descriptive quantitative research. The data sources used in this study come from financial reports and annual reports in the banking sector. The collected data were analyzed using IBM SPSS Statistics 26 statistical software by looking at descriptive statistical tests, classical assumption tests and multiple regression analysis. The results of the study prove that only credit disbursement in the service and business sectors has a positive and significant effect on ROA, while credit disbursement in the construction, trade, and agriculture sectors has a positive but insignificant effect, and credit disbursement in the mining sector has a negative and insignificant effect. NPL has a negative but insignificant effect on ROA, while CASA has a positive and significant effect on ROA. This study confirms that bank profitability is not only determined by the volume of credit disbursement and asset quality, but is also greatly influenced by the efficiency of the funding structure as reflected in the large proportion of CASA funds. Therefore, a banking strategy focused on quality credit growth in productive sectors, consistent NPL control, and increasing the proportion of CASA funds are key factors in strengthening banking financial performance in the long term.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本研究旨在探讨根据不同经济行业发放的贷款金额、不良贷款（NPL）以及活期存款与储蓄存款（CASA）对在印度尼西亚运营的国内外银行盈利能力的影响。研究采用描述性定量研究方法，数据来源于银行业的相关财务报告和年度报告。通过IBM SPSS Statistics 26统计软件对收集到的数据进行了分析，包括描述性统计分析、经典假设检验以及多元回归分析。研究结果表明：仅服务行业和商业行业的贷款发放对银行净资产收益率（ROA）具有显著的正向影响；而建筑、贸易和农业行业的贷款发放虽然对ROA也有正向影响，但效果不显著；采矿行业的贷款发放则对ROA具有负向影响，且影响不显著。不良贷款对ROA具有负向影响，但影响程度较低；相比之下，活期存款对ROA具有显著的正向影响。研究进一步证实，银行的盈利能力不仅取决于贷款发放规模和资产质量，还受到资金结构效率的显著影响，这体现在活期存款在银行总资金中所占比例较高。因此，制定以促进生产性行业优质信贷增长、持续控制不良贷款以及提高活期存款比例为核心的银行发展战略，是提升银行长期财务表现的关键因素。。研究方法：回归分析。
